title: The Ghost of the Free Port
author: M. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Coral Vasquez, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
